# IQAutoMarket

> Iraq's premier unified automotive parts marketplace, AI catalog, and B2B supply network across all 18 governorates.

IQAutoMarket is the unified digital platform for automotive spare parts in Iraq. It provides instant VIN matching, OEM part number cross-referencing, verified merchant inventories, and nationwide logistics.

## Core Services

- [Main Marketplace](https://iqautomarket.com/): Comprehensive genuine OEM and aftermarket automotive parts catalog.
- [Parts Catalog & Search](https://iqautomarket.com/marketplace): Direct search by part name, OEM reference code, or vehicle model.
- [Partline AI Assistant](https://iqautomarket.com/api/partline): Conversational AI assistant for automotive parts compatibility and diagnostic cross-matching.
- [Sanawia Vehicle Card OCR](https://iqautomarket.com/api/documents/scan-sanawia): Optical character recognition for Iraqi vehicle registration cards (سنوية السيارة).
- [Workshop Portal](https://iqautomarket.com/workshops): Dedicated procurement system for automotive garages and fleet operators.
- [Dealer & Supplier Network](https://iqautomarket.com/dealers): Syndicated inventory management and live parts bid dispatching.

## Agentic & Developer Resources

- [Agent Resource Discovery Catalog](https://iqautomarket.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Standardized ARD and WebMCP machine-readable catalog of tools and APIs.
- [ARD Specification Manifest](https://iqautomarket.com/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery manifest adhering to v1.0 standard.
- [XML Sitemap](https://iqautomarket.com/sitemap.xml): XML indexing map of verified parts, categories, and vehicle models.
- [Robots Policy](https://iqautomarket.com/robots.txt): Machine crawling permissions and sitemap references.

## Optional

- [Full LLM Context & Specifications](https://iqautomarket.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation including supported car makes, parts categories, and Iraq governorate shipping matrix.
